# Stackify

> Stackify delivers comprehensive application performance monitoring (APM), error tracking, log management, and code profiling tools for developers across multiple platforms.

Stackify provides end-to-end observability solutions for modern applications with support for .NET, Java, PHP, Node.js, and Ruby. The platform combines APM, real-user monitoring, deployment tracking, and centralized logging into unified tools like Retrace and Prefix.

## Key Topics

- Application Performance Monitoring (APM)
- Error Tracking & Monitoring
- Code Profiling
- Log Management
- Observability
- Real User Monitoring (RUM)
- Deployment Tracking
- DevOps Automation
- .NET Monitoring
- Java APM
- Node.js Monitoring
- PHP Monitoring
- AWS Monitoring
- Retrace
- Prefix

## Core Products

- [Stackify: Application Performance Monitoring Tools For Developers](https://stackify.com): Stackify homepage: APM tools with error tracking, logging, and observability
- [Retrace: Application Performance Management & Observability](https://stackify.com/retrace): Retrace product page: APM, error tracking, and observability solution
- [Prefix: The Developer's Tracing Solution and Code Profiling Tool](https://stackify.com/prefix): Prefix product: code profiling, tracing, and OpenTelemetry support

## Retrace Features & Capabilities

- [Retrace Application Performance Monitoring](https://stackify.com/retrace-application-performance-management): Retrace APM: end-to-end visibility with metrics and Apdex monitoring
- [Retrace Error Monitoring](https://stackify.com/retrace-error-monitoring): Retrace error monitoring: track hidden errors with code profiling
- [Retrace Code Profiling](https://stackify.com/retrace-code-profiling): Retrace code profiling: dynamic analysis with SQL monitoring and tracing
- [Retrace Centralized Log Management](https://stackify.com/retrace-log-management): Retrace log management: centralized logging with search and aggregation
- [Retrace Real User Monitoring](https://stackify.com/retrace-real-user-monitoring): Retrace RUM: frontend monitoring for web performance and user experience
- [Retrace Deployment Tracking](https://stackify.com/retrace-deployment-tracking): Retrace deployment tracking: CI/CD integration and release management
- [Retrace: Monitor Everything About Your Applications](https://stackify.com/retrace-app-monitoring): Retrace overview: combined APM, error tracking, and log management

## Language & Platform Support

- [Retrace .NET Monitoring](https://stackify.com/retrace-apm-dotnet): Retrace for .NET: APM, profiling, and ASP.NET Core monitoring

- [Retrace Node.js Monitoring & APM](https://stackify.com/retrace-apm-nodejs): Retrace for Node.js: APM with error tracking and containerized app support
- [Retrace PHP Monitoring & APM](https://stackify.com/retrace-apm-php): Retrace for PHP: APM with code profiling and real-user monitoring
- [Retrace Ruby Monitoring & APM](https://stackify.com/retrace-apm-ruby): Retrace for Ruby: APM and Rails monitoring with code profiling
